adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a raw-HTML rendering path: `Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), and `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` and `raw: absolutize_urls(...)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed` calls `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` with `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) and does not pass through Readability or any sanitizer. The embed view then renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Therefore RSS item HTML is stored and rendered without sanitization, enabling XSS if the feed content contains unsafe tags/attributes.
